Scan a function over leading array axes while carrying state

Source: R/lax_control.R
lax_scan.Rd

Port of jax.lax.scan: f(carry, x) returns list(new_carry, y); the result is list(final_carry, stacked_ys).

Usage

lax_scan(f, init, xs = NULL, length = NULL, reverse = FALSE, unroll = 1L)

Arguments

f

Function (carry, x).

init

Initial carry (pytree).

xs

Pytree of arrays scanned along their leading axis, or NULL.

length

Number of iterations (required when xs is NULL).

reverse

Scan from the end.

unroll

Number of iterations per loop step, or a logical. Validated as in JAX; the loop is always left rolled.
